title: Kid Rena at the Tea Room and his friendship with Armstrong
summary: Kid Rena was house band leader there with a seven-piece group, a sweet muted trumpeter and Armstrong's right-hand man, a few years younger than Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
